intro.alt: Tarikul Islam, software engineer and full-stack developer
intro.caption: DHAKA, BANGLADESH
intro.p1: I’m |||, a software engineer and full-stack developer from Dhaka, Bangladesh. I focus on backend development with Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript, and build product interfaces with React and Next.js.
intro.p2: I like working on applications where the details connect: designing a data model, shaping an API, and making the interface feel straightforward for the person using it.
intro.p3: My recent work includes tools for education, streaming, and community administration. Away from the code, I’m studying at Bangladesh University of Business & Technology.
